name: T-Mobile
notes: T-Mobile uses a 3-step login: (1) phone/email, (2) choose auth method, (3) password. After login, MFA is required via SMS code. The billing dashboard is at https://www.t-mobile.com/account/dashboard after auth.

billPullSteps.description: Wait for login page to load
Enter phone number or email (Step 1 of login)
billPullSteps.instruction: Type "{{username}}" into the Email or phone number input field

billPullSteps.description: Click Next to proceed to auth method selection
Wait for auth method page to load

billPullSteps.instruction: Click the 'Log in with password' link or button to use password authentication instead of Face ID/Fingerprint

billPullSteps.description: Wait for password form to load

billPullSteps.instruction: Type "{{password}}" into the Password input field

billPullSteps.description: Click Log in to submit credentials
billPullSteps.instruction: Click the 'Log in' button to complete login

billPullSteps.description: Wait for MFA or dashboard to load
If MFA method selection is shown, select SMS and continue
billPullSteps.instruction: If a 'How should we verify your account?' page is shown with radio buttons, select 'Text a code' option if not already selected, then click the 'Continue' button

billPullSteps.description: Wait for SMS code entry page
Check for the MFA code entry prompt after requesting SMS
billPullSteps.instruction: Look for the 6-digit verification code input or a message confirming that a code was sent

billPullSteps.description: Enter MFA verification code (provided via API)
billPullSteps.instruction: Type "{{mfa_code}}" into the 6-digit code input field
Click the 'Continue' button to verify the code

billPullSteps.description: Wait for account dashboard to load after MFA

billPullSteps.instruction: Navigate to the billing section. Click on 'Bill' or 'Billing' in the account navigation menu, or look for a link that shows the current balance or bill amount

billPullSteps.description: Wait for billing page to load
Extract balance and due date from billing page
billPullSteps.instruction: Extract the current bill balance amount as a number (in dollars) and the payment due date as a string. Look for 'Amount due', 'Balance', 'Total', 'Current bill', or similar labels with the associated due date.

mfaDetection.observeInstruction: Look for 'Let\'s confirm it\'s you', verification code input, 'We sent a code', '6-digit code' input, or any security verification prompt
